{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMmSjB1sudZ5ggDPzABf","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-EventNormalise.md ===\n# FEATURE: Event Normalise\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Normalise event time, date and region and provide the shared number-formatting helpers. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-FeedReader.md, ARCHITECTURE.md |\n| Provides    | format_time, region_of, format_mag, format_one_decimal, format_two_decimal |\n| Consumes    | read_events(path) |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nTurn the raw values the reader returns into the text every report writes. These are pure functions\nin modules under the `cli` package, so each is unit-tested on its own.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Function | Input | Output |\n|---|---|---|\n| `format_time(ms)` | integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch | UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, truncated (not rounded) to whole seconds |\n| `region_of(place)` | place text or `None` | text after the last `, ` in `place`, the whole `place` when it has none, `Unknown` for `None` |\n| `format_mag(mag)` | number | one decimal place, so `5` becomes `5.0` |\n| `format_one_decimal(value)` | number | one decimal place, rounded half up (depth and distance) |\n| `format_two_decimal(value)` | number | two decimal places, rounded half up (mean magnitude) |\n\nAn event's date is the first 10 characters of its formatted time. Half-up rounding uses `decimal`\nover `Decimal(str(value))`, never float formatting.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC normalise-format-time ===\nIntent: format_time writes UTC to whole seconds, truncating the milliseconds rather than rounding them.\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nformat_time = find(\"format_time\")\nfor ms in (0, 1735706358208, 1735706358999, 1736211916000, 1767225599999):\n    expected = datetime.fromtimestamp(ms // 1000, timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\")\n    assert format_time(ms) == expected, ms\n=== END AC normalise-format-time ===\n\n=== AC normalise-date-prefix ===\nIntent: The date of an event is the first 10 characters of its time and follows the UTC day boundary.\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nformat_time = find(\"format_time\")\nlast_second = 1735775999999\nnext_day = 1735776000000\nfor ms in (last_second, next_day):\n    day = datetime.fromtimestamp(ms // 1000, timezone.utc).date().isoformat()\n    assert format_time(ms)[:10] == day, ms\nassert format_time(last_second)[:10] != format_time(next_day)[:10]\n=== END AC normalise-date-prefix ===\n\n=== AC normalise-region ===\nIntent: region_of returns the text after the last comma-space, or the whole place when there is none.\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nregion_of = find(\"region_of\")\n\nregion = \"Papua New Guinea\"\nassert region_of(\"64 km NW of Rabaul, \" + region) == region\n\nnested_region = \"Japan\"\nassert region_of(\"Izu Islands, Honshu, \" + nested_region) == nested_region\n\nwhole = \"South Sandwich Islands region\"\nassert region_of(whole) == whole\n\ncomma_no_space = \"Alpha,Beta\"\nassert region_of(comma_no_space) == comma_no_space\n\ntrailing = \"Somewhere, \"\nassert region_of(trailing) == \"\"\n=== END AC normalise-region ===\n\n=== AC normalise-null-place ===\nIntent: A null place has the region Unknown.\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nregion_of = find(\"region_of\")\nassert region_of(None) == \"Unknown\"\n=== END AC normalise-null-place ===\n\n=== AC normalise-format-mag ===\nIntent: format_mag writes one decimal place, including for whole-number magnitudes.\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nformat_mag = find(\"format_mag\")\nfor mag in (5, 5.0, 5.4, 7.1, 6):\n    assert format_mag(mag) == f\"{float(mag):.1f}\", mag\n=== END AC normalise-format-mag ===\n\n=== AC normalise-one-decimal-half-up ===\nIntent: format_one_decimal rounds half up to one decimal place.\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nformat_one_decimal = find(\"format_one_decimal\")\nfor value in (10.25, 2.75, 0.5, 10.0, 46, 358.0, 214.84, 0.25, 1288.35):\n    expected = str(Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal(\"0.1\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))\n    assert format_one_decimal(value) == expected, value\n=== END AC normalise-one-decimal-half-up ===\n\n=== AC normalise-two-decimal-half-up ===\nIntent: format_two_decimal rounds half up to two decimal places.\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nformat_two_decimal = find(\"format_two_decimal\")\nfor value in (5.125, 5.375, 5.0, 5.875, 5.3, 0.005):\n    expected = str(Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))\n    assert format_two_decimal(value) == expected, value\n=== END AC normalise-two-decimal-half-up ===\n\n## User result is computed from the argument.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-MinMagFilter.md ===\n# FEATURE: Min Magnitude Filter\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Keep only events with magnitude at least the --min-mag value, for every report. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-EventNormalise.md, FEATURE-CliDispatch.md |\n| Provides    | filter_min_mag(events, m), --min-mag option |\n| Consumes    | read_events(path) |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`filter_min_mag(events, m)` is a pure function over the event list the reader returns. It keeps\nevents with `mag >= m`, preserving order. It sits in the common pipeline (read, filter, compute,\nformat) shared by every report command, so `--min-mag` means the same thing in all of them. When\n`--min-mag` is absent no filtering beyond the reader's null-magnitude exclusion happens. A\n`--min-mag` value that does not match `-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?` is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC minmag-keeps-at-least ===\nIntent: filter_min_mag keeps events whose magnitude is greater than or equal to the threshold, boundary included.\n\nimport importlib\nimport json\nimport os\nimport pkgutil\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nread_events = find(\"read_events\")\nfilter_min_mag = find(\"filter_min_mag\")\n\nmags = [4.9, 5.0, 5.5, 6.1, 5.0]\nfeats = [\n    {\"type\": \"Feature\",\n     \"properties\": {\"mag\": m, \"place\": \"P\" + str(i), \"time\": 1735700000000 + i * 1000, \"tsunami\": 0},\n     \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [0.0, 0.0, 10]},\n     \"id\": \"ev\" + str(i)}\n    for i, m in enumerate(mags)\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = Path(d) / \"q.geojson\"\n    path.write_text(json.dumps({\"type\": \"FeatureCollection\", \"features\": feats}), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    events = read_events(path)\n    assert len(events) == len(mags)\n    for threshold in (5.0, 5.5, 6.1):\n        kept = filter_min_mag(events, threshold)\n        assert len(kept) == sum(1 for m in mags if m >= threshold), threshold\n=== END AC minmag-keeps-at-least ===\n\n=== AC minmag-extremes ===\nIntent: A threshold below every event keeps all of them and one above every event keeps none.\n\nimport importlib\nimport json\nimport pkgutil\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nread_events = find(\"read_events\")\nfilter_min_mag = find(\"filter_min_mag\")\n\nmags = [5.0, 5.3, 7.1]\nfeats = [\n    {\"type\": \"Feature\",\n     \"properties\": {\"mag\": m, \"place\": \"P\" + str(i), \"time\": 1735700000000 + i * 1000, \"tsunami\": 0},\n     \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [0.0, 0.0, 10]},\n     \"id\": \"ev\" + str(i)}\n    for i, m in enumerate(mags)\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = Path(d) / \"q.geojson\"\n    path.write_text(json.dumps({\"type\": \"FeatureCollection\", \"features\": feats}), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    events = read_events(path)\n    assert len(filter_min_mag(events, 0.0)) == len(mags)\n    assert len(filter_min_mag(events, 9.0)) == 0\n    assert len(filter_min_mag(events, -1.0)) == len(mags)\n=== END AC minmag-extremes ===\n\n=== AC minmag-does-not-mutate ===\nIntent: filter_min_mag returns a new selection and leaves the input event list unchanged.\n\nimport importlib\nimport json\nimport pkgutil\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport cli\n\n\ndef find(name):\n    mods = [cli]\n    for info in pkgutil.walk_packages(cli.__path__, \"cli.\"):\n        try:\n            mods.append(importlib.import_module(info.name))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    for mod in mods:\n        if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nread_events = find(\"read_events\")\nfilter_min_mag = find(\"filter_min_mag\")\n\nmags = [5.0, 6.0, 5.5]\nfeats = [\n    {\"type\": \"Feature\",\n     \"properties\": {\"mag\": m, \"place\": \"P\" + str(i), \"time\": 1735700000000 + i * 1000, \"tsunami\": 0},\n     \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [0.0, 0.0, 10]},\n     \"id\": \"ev\" + str(i)}\n    for i, m in enumerate(mags)\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = Path(d) / \"q.geojson\"\n    path.write_text(json.dumps({\"type\": \"FeatureCollection\", \"features\": feats}), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    events = read_events(path)\n    before = len(events)\n    kept = filter_min_mag(events, 5.5)\n    assert len(events) == before\n    assert len(kept) == sum(1 for m in mags if m >= 5.5)\n=== END AC minmag-does-not-mutate ===\n\n=== AC minmag-malformed-value-usage-error ===\nIntent: A --min-mag value that is not a decimal is a usage error with exit 2 and nothing on standard output.\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"q.geojson\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n        json.dump({\"type\": \"FeatureCollection\", \"features\": []}, fh)\n    for bad in (\"big\", \"5.\", \".5\", \"1e3\"):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"summary\", \"--min-mag\", bad, path)\n        assert code == 2, bad\n        assert out == \"\", bad\n=== END AC minmag-malformed-value-usage-error ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- `--min-mag` applies to every report, never to a subset of them.\n- The comparison is `mag >= m`; an event equal to the threshold is kept.\n- No default threshold is applied when the option is absent.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Summary.md ===\n# FEATURE: Summary\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | The summary report: event count, time span, magnitude range, mean and tsunami count. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-MinMagFilter.md, FEATURE-ExitCodes.md |\n| Provides    | quakes summary |\n| Consumes    | filter_min_mag(events, m), format_time |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`quakes summary [--min-mag <m>] <file>` writes the header `events,first,last,min_mag,max_mag,mean_mag,tsunami`\nand one row. `first` and `last` are the earliest and latest event times, `min_mag` and `max_mag` have\none decimal, `mean_mag` has two decimals rounded half up, and `tsunami` counts events whose `tsunami`\nequals `1`. With no events the row is `0,,,,,,0`. Output is written with the `csv` module and `\\n`\nline endings; the report is computed fully before anything is written.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC summary-values ===\nIntent: The summary row carries the count, earliest and latest time, magnitude range, half-up mean and tsunami count computed from the file.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport json\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\n\ndef iso(ms):\n    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ms // 1000, timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\")\n\n\nmags = [5.0, 5.1, 5.1]\ntimes = [1735800000999, 1735700000000, 1735900000500]\ntsunamis = [1, 0, 1]\nfeats = [\n    {\"type\": \"Feature\",\n     \"properties\": {\"mag\": mags[i], \"place\": \"Place \" + str(i), \"time\": times[i], \"tsunami\": tsunamis[i]},\n     \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [10.0, 20.0, 15]},\n     \"id\": \"ev\" + str(i)}\n    for i in range(len(mags))\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"q.geojson\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n        json.dump({\"type\": \"FeatureCollection\", \"features\": feats}, fh)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"summary\", path)\n\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\nrows = if hasattr(mod, name):\n            return getattr(mod, name)\n    raise AssertionError(\"no function named \" + name + \" under the cli package\")\n\n\nformat_time = find(\"format_time\")\nfor ms in
